name: @a2app/integration-pi
description: Agent App Framework plugin for Pi (earendil-works/pi): the /agent-app launcher command, the six framework skills, and an extension that makes Pi reachable from `agent-app <dir> bridge`. Pi drives the agent-app and a2app CLIs with its own bash tool.
//pi: A Pi package manifest (packages.md). `prompts` ships the /agent-app launcher; `skills` points at the single source of truth at the repo root (../../skills) so a git/local-path install finds them with no copy step; `extensions` registers Pi's headless route for the app→agent bridge. If your Pi rejects an out-of-root skills path, use the CLI instead — `agent-app skills --install ~/.pi/agent/skills` — which is Pi's native global skills dir. See README.

scripts.build: node -e "process.stdout.write('pi plugin: pi loads the extension as TypeScript; no build step\n')"
